title: The Dickson Baseball Dictionary - 5000 Terms Used By Players - Paul Dickson
categoryName: Books & Magazines:Textbooks, Education & Reference:Study Guides & Test Prep
descriptionText: "The Dickson Baseball Dictionary" by Paul Dickson is a comprehensive study guide published in 1989 by Facts On File, Incorporated. This illustrated hardcover book contains 5000 terms used by baseball players, making it an essential resource for students at high school and elementary levels interested in the sport. With 438 pages and measuring 10.6 inches in length and 7.9 inches in width, this first edition publication is a valuable addition to any sports and recreation library."
